title: How many whales were killed in the 20th century?
subtitle: Click your guess for how many whales were hunted in the 20th century, then see it as whales per day, and what it did to the blue whale.
form: ask on a scale (click the number line)
notes: Number line is now log, 1,000 to 100 million (the guess marker starts mid-line at about 300,000, far from 2.9 million); relative tolerance 30 %. Sum of OWID whale-catch (World, 1900–1999) = 2,884,708, blue whales 379,185 (said 'more than were ever alive at one time'), peak 1964 = 82,194 (one every 6.4 min); 2010s = 14,957 for the decade. Blue whales 340,280 → 4,727 (2001), drawn as 70 icons of which 69 fade. One label at a time above the grid (340,000 / 380,000 killed / 5,000 left / ban / 2010s catch). Moratorium said as 'the 1980s'. Engine: the scale's tick numbers and answer label stay small.
